notes.testing: SAT required, superscored; last REA-usable sitting Oct 2, 2027. No TOEFL.
notes.aid: Need-aware for internationals who request aid; decision by Jun 30, 2027 belongs to the parent.
notes.predictions: Built on DP1 grades; May–June 2027 exams are effectively the admissions transcript.
notes.spike: PeakScore: build it, measure whether it works (EE + Essay A + competition), document every number.
notes.counselors: Two private counselors (one ex-MIT, one for European universities) own essay and recommendation strategy. Claude owns execution: dates, drafts on time, evidence log, nothing contradicting them.
